module_summary: Combines 8-bit input with phase-tracked held byte into 16-bit output, firing valid pulse when both input-valid and odd-phase conditions align.

anchors.name: valid_in
anchors.why: Input strobe signal driving the phase-hold child and gating output combination.

anchors.name: data_in
anchors.why: 8-bit input data payload, lower byte of the final 16-bit output.

anchors.name: valid_out
anchors.why: Output valid pulse strobing 16-bit result when combination fires.

anchors.name: data_out
anchors.why: 16-bit output register holding the concatenated result.

anchors.name: fire_k
anchors.why: Combines valid_in and u_parity; gates both valid_out pulse and data_out update.

anchors.name: u_pending
anchors.why: Holds high byte from child phase_hold module, concatenated as upper 8 bits of output.

anchors.name: u_parity
anchors.why: Odd-phase toggle from child, used to gate fire condition with valid_in.

groups.name: Input Interface
groups.description: Receives valid strobe and 8-bit data input.

groups.name: Child Module Outputs
groups.description: High byte holding register and odd-phase control flag from child phase_hold module.

groups.name: Output Fire Logic
groups.description: Combines valid_in and u_parity to gate output register updates.
